title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 45
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 45: the holy portion of the land, just weights and measures, and the offerings of the prince.

questions.text: What are the length and the width of the holy portion offered to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The holy portion of the land shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length and ten thousand in width, holy in all its border around.

answers.text: Twenty-five thousand by ten thousand
Ten thousand by ten thousand
Five hundred by five hundred
One hundred by one hundred

questions.text: What square is set apart for the holy place, and how much pasture land around it?
questions.explanation: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

answers.text: One hundred square, with ten cubits around
Twenty-five square, with five cubits around
Five hundred square, with fifty cubits around
Fifty square, with five hundred cubits around

questions.text: For whom is the portion that is a possession with twenty rooms?
questions.explanation: Twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

answers.text: For the singers of the house
For the Levites, the ministers of the house
For the servants of the prince
For the people of the land

questions.text: What are the measurements of the possession of the city, and for whom is it?
questions.explanation: The possession of the city shall be five thousand wide and twenty-five thousand long, and it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

answers.text: Ten thousand by ten thousand, for the priests
Five hundred square, for the prince
One thousand square, for the Levites
Five thousand by twenty-five thousand, for all Israel

questions.text: What are the princes of Israel told to remove, and what to execute?
questions.explanation: The princes of Israel are told to remove violence and plunder, and to execute justice and righteousness.

answers.text: Remove violence and plunder, execute justice
Remove the idols from the high places
Build a wall around the whole city
Measure out the land again by lot

questions.text: What three things must they have, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: They shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

answers.text: A large ephah, a small bath, and a light shekel
Just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath
One balance kept by the prince
New weights made of pure gold

questions.text: How much shall the ephah and the bath each contain?
questions.explanation: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, so that the bath contains one tenth of a homer and the ephah one tenth of a homer.

answers.text: One sixth of a homer
One half of a homer
Ten homers
One tenth of a homer

questions.text: How many gerahs shall the shekel be?
questions.explanation: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs.

answers.text: Ten
Fifteen
Twenty
Twenty-five

questions.text: On which day of the first month shall the Passover be, and how long is the feast?
questions.explanation: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, they shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days, and unleavened bread shall be eaten.

answers.text: The first day, a feast of three days
The fourteenth day, a feast of seven days
The seventh day, a feast of eight days
The tenth day, a feast of two days

questions.text: In which month and on which day shall the prince do the same for seven days, in the feast?
questions.explanation: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, in the feast, he shall do like that for seven days.

answers.text: The first month, the fourteenth day
The seventh month, the first day
The second month, the tenth day
The seventh month, the fifteenth day
